doc: Unit directions of the texel centers of a 16x8 north-up equirectangular grid, float32 (z north). Computed in float64 and rounded to float32 once, so a float64 port matches within half a float32 ulp (6e-8); measured against the same grid with float32 trigonometry: 1.2e-7 at most, so the tolerance is 10x that (2e-6 abs, 1e-5 rel).
